title: Small-C 2.5 — native 8086 C compiler (DOS)
notes: Public-domain K&R-subset C compiler that runs on the 8086 DOS service layer (bw-board run-dos.mjs). Proven: cc.exe prints its banner and emits 8086 assembly. Full build is cc->asm->ylink sharing a DOS filesystem; run-dos runs one program at a time, so compile->assemble->link->run end-to-end needs a persistent-FS DOS session (tracked).
